rules.when: work.days.exists(d, d.scheduled_hours > (has(terms.facts.normal_hours_per_day) ? double(terms.facts.normal_hours_per_day) : (terms.work_classification == "HAZARDOUS" ? 7.0 : 8.0))) || work.days.exists(d, sum(work.days.filter(e, int(calendar_distance_days("2024-01-01", e.date)) / 7 == int(calendar_distance_days("2024-01-01", d.date)) / 7).map(e, e.scheduled_hours)) > (has(terms.facts.normal_hours_per_day) ? double(terms.facts.normal_hours_per_day) : (terms.work_classification == "HAZARDOUS" ? 7.0 : 8.0)) * 6.0)
rules.message: Normal working time exceeds 8 hours a day or 48 a week (7 and 42 for hazardous work) (LPA s.23).
rules.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.23 and Ministerial Regulation No. 2: normal time at most 8 hours a day and 48 a week; for work harmful to health 7 and 42. Weekly limit read as 6 × the daily limit over a Monday-Sunday week of planned hours. Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).

rules.when: work.days.exists(d, d.worked_hours - d.overtime_hours > 5.0 && size(d.intervals) == 1)
rules.message: A day of more than five consecutive working hours was recorded without a rest break (LPA s.27).
rules.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.27: a rest period of at least one hour after no more than five consecutive working hours (or shorter breaks totalling an hour by agreement); 20 minutes before overtime of two hours or more. A single recorded interval of more than five normal hours shows no break. Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).

rules.when: work.days.exists(d, size(work.days.filter(e, e.date >= d.date && e.date <= add_days(d.date, 6) && e.worked)) >= 7)
rules.message: Seven consecutive days were worked without a weekly holiday (LPA s.28).
rules.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.28: at least one weekly holiday a week, no more than six days apart; in hotel, transport, forest or remote work it may be accumulated within four weeks by prior agreement. Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).

rules.when: (work.days.exists(d, d.overtime_hours > 0.0 && !(has(d.overtime_consented) && d.overtime_consented)) || work.holidays.exists(h, h.worked && !work.days.exists(d, d.date == h.date && (has(d.overtime_consented) && d.overtime_consented)))) && !(has(terms.facts.continuous_work) && terms.facts.continuous_work)
rules.message: Overtime or holiday work was paid without the employee's recorded prior consent (LPA ss.24-25).
rules.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.24: overtime only with the employee's prior consent each time, except continuous or emergency work; s.25: holiday work likewise, beyond the listed undertakings. Consent is per day (owner ruling): a day with paid overtime, or a published holiday worked, without that day's recorded consent (work.days[].overtime_consented, from the work-day sheet) warns; contract fact continuous_work exempts. Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).

rules.when: (has(employee.facts.pregnant) && employee.facts.pregnant) && (sum(work.days.map(d, d.overtime_hours)) > 0.0 || work.holidays.exists(h, h.worked) || work.days.exists(d, hours_between(d.intervals, "22:00", "06:00") > 0.0))
rules.message: A pregnant employee worked overtime, on a holiday or between 22:00 and 06:00 (LPA s.39).
rules.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.39: no work 22:00-06:00, overtime or holiday work for a pregnant employee (s.39/1 allows executive, academic, clerical or financial work with her consent); s.43: no dismissal for pregnancy. Customer input: employee fact pregnant. Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).

rules.when: (employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, period.to) < 18) && (sum(work.days.map(d, d.overtime_hours)) > 0.0 || work.holidays.exists(h, h.worked) || work.days.exists(d, hours_between(d.intervals, "22:00", "06:00") > 0.0))
rules.message: An employee under 18 worked overtime, on a holiday or between 22:00 and 06:00 (LPA ss.47-48).
rules.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.47: no work 22:00-06:00 for a child under 18 without the Director-General's permission; s.48: no overtime or holiday work. Wages are paid to the child (s.52). Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).

rules.when: employee.date_of_birth != "" && age_on(employee.date_of_birth, day) < 15
rules.message: An employee under 15 may not be employed (LPA s.44).
rules.description: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.44: no employer shall employ a child under 15. Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).

rules.when: !(has(term.facts) && term.facts != null && has(term.facts.pay_basis) && term.facts.pay_basis == "PIECE") && has(term.facts) && term.facts != null && has(term.facts.skill_standard_day_rate) && ((has(term.facts.pay_basis) && term.facts.pay_basis == "DAILY") ? term.base_salary : term.monthly_wage / 30.0) < double(term.facts.skill_standard_day_rate)

rules.authority: Office of the Prime Minister notification on annual government holidays (24 May 2019) with the Cabinet resolution of 2 December 2025 on the 2026 government holidays (Secretariat of the Cabinet summary, item 9) https://thaipublica.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B8%E0%B8%9B%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%95%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%93%E0%B8%B0%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%90%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%95%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B5-2-%E0%B8%98%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%84%E0%B8%A1-2568.pdf: the 2026 list of 22 days (the Royal Ploughing Ceremony day is announced yearly by the Bureau of the Royal Household and is not listed). Created unpublished for each entity: under LPA s.29 the employer announces at least 13 traditional holidays a year including National Labour Day (1 May) from these, and a holiday falling on the weekly holiday moves to the next working day. Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).

rules.when: (has(terms.facts.pay_basis) && terms.facts.pay_basis == "PIECE") && !(has(company.facts.minimum_wage_exempt) && company.facts.minimum_wage_exempt) && company.region in rules.minimum_wage.by_region && sum(work.days.filter(d, !(d.holiday_kind != "" || d.day_type == "REST")).map(d, (has(d.facts) && d.facts != null && has(d.facts.units) ? double(d.facts.units) : 0.0))) * (has(terms.facts.piece_rate) ? double(terms.facts.piece_rate) : 0.0) < double((has(company.facts.minimum_wage_400_business) && company.facts.minimum_wage_400_business ? rules.minimum_wage.business_400 : rules.minimum_wage.by_region[company.region])) * double(size(work.days.filter(d, !(d.holiday_kind != "" || d.day_type == "REST") && d.worked)))
rules.message: The piece-work wages of the normal days worked are below the area minimum wage for those days (Wage Committee Notification No. 14 cl.19-20).
rules.description: Wage Committee Notification on Minimum Wage Rates (No. 14) cl.19-20 (a "day" is the normal working time; no wage below the area rate) with LPA s.90: a piece worker's pay for the normal days worked is at least the area day rate for each of them. https://ratchakitcha.soc.go.th/documents/76681.pdf

rules.when: day.worked && !(day.holiday_kind != "" || day.day_type == "REST") && day.worked_hours - day.overtime_hours > (has(terms.facts.normal_hours_per_day) ? double(terms.facts.normal_hours_per_day) : (terms.work_classification == "HAZARDOUS" ? 7.0 : 8.0))
rules.message: normal hours above 8 in the day (7 in hazardous work) (LPA s.23).
rules.description: normal hours above 8 in the day (7 in hazardous work) (LPA s.23).
rules.authority: LPA s.23 para 1: normal working time at most 8 hours a day and 48 a week; hazardous work at most 7 hours a day and 42 a week (term fact normal_hours_per_day for a lower agreed day). Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541, Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf)

rules.when: week.worked_hours - week.overtime_hours > 6.0 * (has(terms.facts.normal_hours_per_day) ? double(terms.facts.normal_hours_per_day) : (terms.work_classification == "HAZARDOUS" ? 7.0 : 8.0))
rules.message: normal hours above 48 (42 in hazardous work) in the seven days ending on this day (LPA s.23).
rules.description: normal hours above 48 (42 in hazardous work) in the seven days ending on this day (LPA s.23).
rules.authority: LPA s.23 para 1: at most 48 normal hours a week (42 in hazardous work). Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541, Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf)

rules.when: day.overtime_hours > 0.0 && week.overtime_hours_by_day_type.WORK + week.overtime_hours_by_day_type.REST + week.overtime_hours_by_day_type.OFF > 36.0
rules.message: more than 36 overtime hours, rest-day and holiday overtime included, in the seven days ending on this day (LPA s.26).
rules.description: more than 36 overtime hours, rest-day and holiday overtime included, in the seven days ending on this day (LPA s.26).
rules.authority: LPA s.26 and Ministerial Regulation No. 3 (B.E. 2541): overtime and holiday work together at most 36 hours a week, so overtime on working, rest and holiday days all counts (each day once, by its planned type). Holiday work in normal hours also counts but the sheet’s week does not hold it; that part stays the payslip check OVERTIME_WEEKLY_CAP. Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541, Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf)

rules.when: day.worked && (day.overtime_hours > 0.0 || (day.holiday_kind != "" && day.holiday_kind != "MAKEUP_WORKDAY")) && !(has(day.overtime_consented) && day.overtime_consented) && !(has(terms.facts.continuous_work) && terms.facts.continuous_work)
rules.message: overtime or holiday work on this day without the employee's recorded consent for the day (LPA ss.24-25).
rules.description: overtime or holiday work on this day without the employee's recorded consent for the day (LPA ss.24-25).
rules.authority: LPA s.24: overtime only with the employee's prior consent each time, except continuous or emergency work; s.25: holiday work likewise. Consent is the sheet's per-day consent (day.overtime_consented; owner ruling: never a contract or company setting). Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541, Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf)

rules.when: day.worked_hours - day.overtime_hours > 5.0 && size(day.intervals) == 1
rules.message: five or more working hours with no recorded rest break (LPA s.27).
rules.description: five or more working hours with no recorded rest break (LPA s.27).
rules.authority: LPA s.27 para 1: a rest period of at least one hour after no more than five consecutive working hours. Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541, Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf)

rules.when: day.worked && week.worked_days >= 7
rules.message: seven days in a row worked without the weekly holiday (LPA s.28).
rules.description: seven days in a row worked without the weekly holiday (LPA s.28).
rules.authority: LPA s.28 para 1: at least one weekly holiday a week, at intervals of no more than six days. Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541, Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf)

rules.when: has(employee.facts.pregnant) && employee.facts.pregnant == true && day.worked && (day.overtime_hours > 0.0 || hours_between(day.intervals, "22:00", "06:00") > 0.0 || (day.holiday_kind != "" || day.day_type == "REST"))
rules.message: a pregnant employee worked overtime, at night (22:00–06:00) or on a holiday (LPA s.39).
rules.description: a pregnant employee worked overtime, at night (22:00–06:00) or on a holiday (LPA s.39).
rules.authority: LPA s.39: an employer shall not have a pregnant employee work between 22:00 and 06:00, overtime or on a holiday (employee.facts.pregnant). Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541, Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf)

rules.when: employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && day.worked && double(age_on(employee.date_of_birth, day.date)) < 18.0 && (day.overtime_hours > 0.0 || hours_between(day.intervals, "22:00", "06:00") > 0.0 || (day.holiday_kind != "" || day.day_type == "REST"))
rules.message: an employee under 18 worked overtime, at night (22:00–06:00) or on a holiday (LPA ss.47–48).
rules.description: an employee under 18 worked overtime, at night (22:00–06:00) or on a holiday (LPA ss.47–48).
rules.authority: LPA s.47: no work for an employee under 18 between 22:00 and 06:00 without the Director-General’s permission; s.48: no overtime or holiday work. Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541, Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf)

rules.when: employee.date_of_birth != null && employee.date_of_birth != "" && day.worked && double(age_on(employee.date_of_birth, day.date)) < 15.0
rules.message: a child under 15 may not be employed (LPA s.44): remove the day.
rules.description: a child under 15 may not be employed (LPA s.44): remove the day.
rules.authority: LPA s.44: an employer shall not employ a child under 15. The contract site refuses the same (CHILD_EMPLOYMENT). Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541, Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf)

rules.description: Pay the SSO late-remittance surcharge.
rules.authority: Social Security Act B.E. 2533 s.49 para 1 (as amended by No. 4 B.E. 2558): a contribution not remitted, or short, by the s.47 day bears a surcharge of 2% a month of the unremitted amount from the day after it was due, at most the contribution itself; para 2: a contribution the employer failed to deduct is still the employer's to remit with the surcharge. Raised when the remittance is recorded paid after its due day; the surcharge is paid with it. https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/download/download_by_pool_file/47435
rules.when: row.state == "FULFILLED" && row.duty_code == "SSO_CONTRIBUTION_REMITTANCE" && has(row.fulfilled_on) && row.fulfilled_on != null && row.fulfilled_on > row.due_on

rules.description: Pay the PND1 late-payment surcharge.
rules.authority: Revenue Code s.27: tax not paid or remitted in time bears a surcharge of 1.5% a month or part of a month of the tax, from the day after the deadline to the payment day, at most the tax (0.75% within an extension). Raised when the PND1 remittance is recorded paid after its due day. https://www.rd.go.th/english/37745.html
rules.when: row.state == "FULFILLED" && row.duty_code == "PND1_FILING" && has(row.fulfilled_on) && row.fulfilled_on != null && row.fulfilled_on > row.due_on

rules.description: Deposit 25% of the year's WCF contribution (instalment payer).
rules.authority: Ministry of Labour notification of 21 February 2019 cl.16-17: an employer allowed to pay the WCF contribution by instalments (entity fact wcf_instalments, the SSO's approval) deposits 25% of the estimated year's contribution within January. https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/download/download_by_pool_file/14479

rules.description: Pay the quarter's WCF instalment and report its wages.
rules.authority: Ministry of Labour notification of 21 February 2019 cl.18: the instalment payer pays in four instalments a year, each within the month after its quarter ends, reporting the quarter's total wages. https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/download/download_by_pool_file/14479

rules.description: Pay the Workmen’s Compensation Fund late-payment surcharge: 2% a month of the contribution not remitted, or short, from the day after its due day, at most the contribution itself. Raised when a WCF contribution task (the annual or additional contribution, the instalment deposit or an instalment) is marked done after its due day; the surcharge is paid with it.
rules.authority: Workmen’s Compensation Act B.E. 2537 s.46 para 1 (as amended by No. 2 B.E. 2561), Office of the Council of State translation published by the SSO https://www.sso.go.th/wpr/download/download_by_pool_file/47436
rules.when: row.state == "DONE" && row.code in ["WCF_ANNUAL_CONTRIBUTION", "WCF_ADDITIONAL_CONTRIBUTION", "WCF_INSTALMENT_DEPOSIT", "WCF_INSTALMENT"] && has(row.done_on) && row.done_on != null && row.done_on > row.due_on

rules.description: Pay the year's Skill Development Fund contribution with Sor Tor 2 within March of the following year: the lowest statutory minimum daily wage × 30 × the employees short of training 50% of the year's average headcount × the months the employer had 100 or more employees ÷ 100. Raised with the December run over the year's month-end headcounts and the registrar-certified trained count (entity fact sdf_trained_employees); a zero contribution is not raised.
rules.authority: Skill Development Promotion Act B.E. 2545 (as amended B.E. 2557) s.30; Department of Skill Development guidance for employers in the compulsory scheme (contribution formula and example) https://www.dsd.go.th/sdpaa/Region/Download_Doc/13824
rules.amount: round(337.0 * 30.0 * max(0.0, round(0.5 * (sum(headcount_months.map(m, double(m.headcount))) / 12.0), 1.0, "UP") - (has(company.facts.sdf_trained_employees) ? double(company.facts.sdf_trained_employees) : 0.0)) * double(size(headcount_months.filter(m, double(m.headcount) >= 100.0))) / 100.0, 0.01, "HALF_UP")

rules.authority: PDPA s.26 (Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (Government Gazette vol.136 part 69 Gor, 27 May 2019), unofficial English translation (https://cc.kmutt.ac.th/Files/Act%20Eng/personal-data-protection-act-2019-en.pdf))

rules.authority: PDPA ss.28–29 (Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (Government Gazette vol.136 part 69 Gor, 27 May 2019), unofficial English translation (https://cc.kmutt.ac.th/Files/Act%20Eng/personal-data-protection-act-2019-en.pdf))

Raised when the entity is created.
rules.authority: PDPA s.39 (Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (Government Gazette vol.136 part 69 Gor, 27 May 2019), unofficial English translation (https://cc.kmutt.ac.th/Files/Act%20Eng/personal-data-protection-act-2019-en.pdf))
